The '''Dragon Nest''' is a cave east of [[Tal Teklan]] in the [[Tlati Rainforest]]. Completion of [[Children of the Sun]] is required to access the Rainforest, but the Nest has no other requirements to access. It is visited as part of the [[Scrambled!]] quest, where the player must retrieve a [[Dragon egg (Scrambled!)|dragon egg]] from the south-east corner of the cave. Upon attempting to take the egg, the player is attacked by and must defeat a [[Red dragon (Scrambled!)|red dragon]].

Dragon Nest contains 5 [[Blue dragon|blue dragons]] and 5 [[Red dragon|red dragons]], in addition to 2 [[Baby blue dragon|baby blue dragons]] and 2 [[Baby red dragon|baby red dragons]]. Item spawns include 4 [[Blue dragon scales|blue dragon scales]], some [[burnt bone]]s, and a number of coin spawns.

A [[Dwarf multicannon|cannon]] can be set up in the cave.
